Roasting brings out the sweetness of tomatoes, even ordinary winter ones.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 kg tomatoes, halved
* 1 red onion, cut into wedges
* 1 head of garlic, top sliced off
* 3 tablespoons olive oil, plus extra to serve
* 1 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste
* 1/2 teaspoon sugar (optional, for very sharp tomatoes)
* 500 ml vegetable stock
* A few basil leaves

== Method ==
# Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
# Spread the tomatoes, cut side up, and the onion on a large tray. Wrap the garlic in foil and add it to the tray. Drizzle everything with oil and season with salt.
# Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft and catching at the edges.
# Squeeze the garlic out of its skins into a pot. Add the tomatoes, onion, any juices from the tray and the stock.
# Simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth. Taste, adjust the salt, and add the sugar if the soup tastes sharp.
# Serve with torn basil and a little more olive oil.

== Tips ==
* For a creamier soup, stir in a few spoons of cream or coconut milk after blending.
* Blending hot liquid can push the lid off. Fill the blender only halfway and hold the lid down with a towel, or use a stick blender in the pot.
